2:77.text: not that Allâh knows what they conceal and what they reveal?

2:78.text: unlettered people, who know not the Book, but they trust upon false desires and they but guess.

2:79.text: Then woe to those who write the Book with their own hands and then say, "This is from Allâh," to purchase with it a little price! Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for that they earn thereby.

2:80.text: (i.e. Hell-fire on the Day of Resurrection)
shall not touch us but for a few numbered days." Say
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to them)
: "Have you taken a covenant from Allâh, so that Allâh will not break His Covenant? Or is it that you say of Allâh what you know not?"

2:81.text: Yes! Whosoever earns evil and his sin has surrounded him, they are dwellers of the Fire

2:82.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh تعالى - Islâmic Monotheism)
and do righteous good deeds, they are dwellers of Paradise, they will dwell therein forever.

2:83.text: when We took a covenant from the Children of Israel,
and be dutiful and good to parents, and to kindred, and to orphans and Al-Masâkîn
[i.e. enjoin righteousness and forbid evil, and say the truth about Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم]
, and give Zakât. Then you slid back, except a few of you, while you are backsliders.
